sections.title: Bibó and the essay
sections.content: Bibó István (1911–1979) wrote *A kelet-európai kisállamok nyomorúsága* in 1946. The reading is an original text about this essay and about his idea of *politikai hisztéria* (political hysteria), his own term for a community that gives up its moral standards out of fear.

sections.title: What you know: the -va/-ve participle
sections.content: You know the adverbial participle in *-va/-ve* from B1 Unit 29. It gives the background of a statement: `A félelmeket elemezve megérthetjük a politikai hisztériát.` (By analysing fears we can understand political hysteria.) The new words are *hamis realizmus*, *félelem légköre*, *demokratikus érettség*.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A félelmeket elemezve megérthetjük a politikai hisztériát.
By analysing fears we can understand political hysteria.
A szöveg szerint a félelem légkörében nehéz szabadnak lenni.
According to the text, it is hard to be free in a climate of fear.
A múltat megismerve jobban értjük a mai félelmeket.
Knowing the past, we understand today's fears better.
